infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fern uses your microphone when you tap to talk to her. Your recording is sent to our speech service only to turn it into text.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fern checks whether you are at one of your saved stores so it can open that store's list and sale items.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Fern checks in the background whether you have arrived at one of your saved stores, so it can send a store alert. Only your saved stores are checked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Fern checks in the background whether you have arrived at one of your saved stores, so it can send a store alert. Only your saved stores are checked.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fern uses your camera to photograph store flyers, add photos to your recipes and cookbooks, and snap your fridge for recipe ideas.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fern uses your photos so you can pick a store flyer, a recipe or cookbook photo, or a fridge photo for recipe ideas.
